reviewer_notes: Rejected (not accepted as a strategic/governance finding): this passage discusses the AI investment theme, a portfolio holding's own AI adoption, or stewardship engagement with a portfolio company about its AI practices -- not the Trust's own operational or governance use of generative AI. The project's unit of analysis is a generative-AI use case BY the FTSE 100 constituent itself (Core Rule 1), not commentary on companies it invests in -- the same principle already applied to exclude a Non-Executive Director's own outside company (Endeavour Mining, session 3).
